programmes.show_description: Ant and Dec host as two new campmates join the famous faces and it remains to be seen if the latest celebrities fit into camp or drama will ensue. Lots of differing opinions lead to dramatic conclusions, and the campmates continue to battle it out
News, sport and weather from across Scotland

Henry Agg presents an upcycling masterclass in response to a viewer's question and Poppy Okotcha gives tips on bringing more wildlife into the garden. Camilla Bassett-Smith visits a striking Welsh garden and Claire Lowrie offers her houseplant styling essentials
Morning magazine featuring a lively mix of news and current affairs, plus health, entertainment and lifestyle features
A mix of celebrity chat, lifestyle features, advice and competitions
The key headlines from the day so far

Stephen Mulhern hosts as contestants Roisin Conaty, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sunetra Sarker 'see it and say it' as they try to guess the familiar phrases hidden in animated clues. After the first elimination, the two remaining players battle to reach the Super Catchphrase round, where one of them could win £50,000 for the charity of their choice

David Dickinson helps people in Stoke-on-Trent to sort treasures from their trash. Stewart Hofgartner gets something that really rings his bell, Fay Rutter pays out towards a world tour, Tim Hogarth spies a French biscuit poster, and a huge collection of cigarette cards bring an emotional result at auction
Join Stephen Mulhern for another nail-biting Deal or No Deal. But will today's contestant beat The Banker? or Will they become the latest member of the 1p club?

Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

Bradley Walsh presents as Chris from Kent, Ros from Leominster, Angela from Warrington and Giovanni originally from Venice pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught
By Reform UK
A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world

England v Spain (Kick-off 7.00pm). Seema Jaswal presents all the action from the FIFA World Cup Group A3 match at Wembley Stadium. These teams met in the finals of both the 2023 World Cup and Euro 2025, with Spain taking the honours of the first of them, before the Lionesses avenged that defeat on penalties last year. Both sides have won their first two matches in this qualifying campaign against Ukraine and Iceland, and it looks like the two contests between these nations will decide who earns an automatic place in the finals. With analysis from Karen Carney and Anita Asante, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Siobhan Chamberlain, and reports from Katie Shanahan

Ant and Dec host as the two new kings proudly push their kingdoms into battle and with a fence running through camp, they are not only divided in numbers but also in opinions. Who will the kings choose to take on the trials and who will ultimately be victorious and win the bush banquet and safari
A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents
